nodes.label: PNJ gold price API (SJC bars + plain ring)
nodes.norm_label: pnj gold price api (sjc bars + plain ring)
nodes.rationale: Single point of failure for both Vietnamese rows; returns units of 10,000 d, HCM zone=00.

nodes.label: Known limitations (no DOJI, no sjc.com.vn, PNJ SPOF)
nodes.norm_label: known limitations (no doji, no sjc.com.vn, pnj spof)

nodes.label: Environment config (PORT, REFRESH_MINUTES, DATA_DIR, *_URL overrides)
nodes.rationale: REFRESH_MINUTES floored at 5 due to Vietcombank rate limit; URL overrides allow simulating outages.

nodes.label: History snapshots table (src/history.js, node:sqlite)
nodes.rationale: Insert only on buy/sell change, else extend seen_until, so charts distinguish 'price unchanged' from 'app not running'.

nodes.label: Gap calculation (world_vnd_luong, gap, gap_%)
nodes.rationale: 1 luong = 37.5 g; ignores VAT, import, fabrication, transport - reference only.

nodes.label: GitHub Pages static version
nodes.rationale: Pages can't run Node/SQLite, so visitor's browser fetches sources directly; no history, no Swissquote, no stale values.

nodes.label: GitHub Pages build (pages/, pages.yml)
nodes.rationale: Shared modules must stay browser-safe (no node: imports); header-less fetch avoids CORS preflight; Swissquote and Can Tho stores lack CORS so only work locally.

nodes.label: Scheduler file lock (DATA_DIR/scheduler.lock)
nodes.rationale: Only the lock holder runs the scheduler and writes history; other processes serve pages in standby. OS releases the lock if the process dies.

nodes.label: Slots and refresh cycle (scheduler.js)
nodes.rationale: A slot is one displayed row with ordered primary->fallback sources and a pick function; refreshOnce dedupes so each fetcher is called once per cycle.

nodes.label: Stale slot fallback (Du lieu cu)
nodes.rationale: If all sources for a slot fail, keep previous quotes and mark stale: true so other rows are unaffected.

nodes.label: Normalized quote {source, code, product, buy, sell, unit, currency, fetched_at}
nodes.norm_label: normalized quote {source, code, product, buy, sell, unit, currency, fetched_at}

nodes.label: Gia vang tai Can Tho (store price tables)
nodes.norm_label: gia vang tai can tho (store price tables)
nodes.rationale: Stores quote per chi; app x10 to d/luong. Gap shown only for near-pure gold. No history; not on GitHub Pages (no CORS).

nodes.label: Minh Vu store (homepage HTML table)
nodes.rationale: Unit not stated; per chi inferred from number size and enforced by range check. Updates rarely.

nodes.rationale: Pure parse(raw, fetchedAt) enables fixture-based tests without network; parsers throw on unexpected payloads and use range guards to catch silent unit changes.
